articles.summary: Benzinga: Alibaba Steps Up AI Race With Potential Nvidia Mega Order. Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. (NYSE:BABA) stock rose Thursday after reports signaled expanded access to Nvidia Corp.'s (NASDAQ:NVDA) advanced artificial intelligence chips in China. The Chinese e-commerce giant pared some of those gains in early Friday trading, following a rally of more than 5% the prior session. The Thursday move came after reports that China may approve limited imports of Nvidia's H200 chips as soon as this quarter.
